target: a Task-tool subagent envelope never passes through finalize_envelope, so nothing normalises it — observe.sh must read result.findings itself
cmd: jq -n '{worker:"sonnet",status:"ok",summary:"s",result:{findings:[{claim:"c",evidence:"e",severity:"high"},{claim:"d",evidence:"e",severity:"low"}]},artifacts:[],key_decisions:[],caveats:[],assumptions:[],confidence_ordinal:"high",usage:{}}' > msg.json; printf %s "{\"hook_event_name\":\"SubagentStop\",\"agent_type\":\"loop-reviewer\",\"agent_id\":\"a\",\"session_id\":\"s\",\"last_assistant_message\":$(jq -Rs . < msg.json)}" > h.json; AGENTIC_OBSERVE=1 bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" hook SubagentStop < h.json; jq -c "select(.event==\"agent_stop\") | {c: .detail.findings_count}" .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | tail -1
